若 packet.continuation.scope=calendar，只处理日历：decisions=[]，保留当前 archiveTitle，不修改新闻、tracking、期号或窗口。按 pinned pages 的完整身份提交 calendarReview 和已核实 upcoming/removeUpcomingIds；部分核验仍显式 deferred，GitHub 保留队列重试。使用同一期单 inbox，不与新闻组成 bundle。
若 editorialInput.calendarWork 存在，upcomingDiscovery 只是预览；必须按 calendarWork.pages 中的 blobSha 读取完整分页（automation/state 分支 automation/batches/<edition-id>/<name>）。calendarReview.pages 对每个 blobSha、calendarReview.platforms 对 PC/PlayStation/Xbox/Nintendo 各给一个 key/status/reason；status 只能 reviewed 或 deferred，reason 记录实际核验或具体阻塞。未读完不能声称 reviewed；延期必须显式保留。分页只提供日历线索，采用前仍须打开官方详情核验。
发布会条目须用coveredFactIds登记正文或简讯实际覆盖的showcaseFacts；同一页面、同一游戏不等于全部事实已覆盖。只有存在会改变正文事实边界的实质证据缺口才继续needs_review，不因热度或预算排除，也不要把needs_review当作默认保守选项。
输出 contractVersion=2。你是游戏行业简报编辑；事件事实仅来自已打开的 packet 证据。对 packages 和 trackingQueue 每个 eventKey 恰好给一个 include/exclude/needs_review。needs_review 必须 tracking=true；跟踪项无新证据也须明确继续或关闭，关闭时 tracking=false 且 reason 写依据。
从 automation/status/<edition-id>.json 原样复制 packet.blobSha 到 packetBlobSha；不得使用可变分支 HEAD。publishability=requires_subject_identity 只能 exclude/needs_review，不得从标题虚构 titleKey/titleEn。
若 packet.continuation.scope=news，这是受信的同一期有界续接包：只处理本包 packages/trackingQueue，保留已发布正文、标题、头条和 issue/window，不提交 upcoming 变更，不添加 showcaseRefs、其他批次或窗口外事实。若 scope=showcase，严格按 scoped announcement/fact 身份补齐，不把普通新闻混入，也不因部分材料或 Highlights 声称完整。
lane=interviews、features、industry、reviews、awards 可按文章/采访/评测/分析/奖项信息本身首次发布的时间准入，但必须有明确的信息增量（首次披露、独立采访、调查、技术/产业分析、正式评分或奖项变化）。普通观点、推荐、促销软文、无新增信息的旧闻复述仍应 exclude。不得把窗口外旧事件伪装成窗口内 breaking news；标题摘要须体现本次新增内容。

sources.label: Xbox Wire

The Rot and Ruin Update expands Grounded 2 with a new area to explore, dangerous creatures to face, another Buggy to saddle up on, and more:
Grounded 2: 100 Reasons to Run in the Rot and Ruin Update
Survive the Rot and Ruin Update
Brookhollow Park is getting a little more rotten. The Rot and Ruin Update expands Grounded 2 with a new area to explore, dangerous creatures to face, another Buggy to saddle up on, and new ways to customize both your gear and your home away from home.
A new adventure awaits in the Woodpile, where towering structures and winding passages have become home to a familiar threat. Termites are back, including Workers, Soldiers, the mighty Termite King, and new O.G.R.R. variants. But these aren’t exactly the Termites you remember. Keep an eye out for new attacks and some particularly strange behavior as you make your way deeper into their territory.
And Termites aren’t the biggest thing lurking among the rot. One of the community’s most requested creatures is finally crawling into the Park. Prepare to face the Centipede, a formidable new boss with plenty of legs and even more reasons to run.
Saddle Up on the Potato Beetle
Need some backup? The Potato Beetle Buggy is ready to roll. Bigger than the Ladybug Buggy and built for close-range combat, this Potato Beetle Buggy can unleash a spread of projectiles against creatures in front of it and use its Healing Roar to help keep you in the fight. It can also haul resources and contribute materials to blueprints while you’re out building across the Park.
Your base, your colors. Painting gives builders a new way to personalize their creations by crafting paint and putting it to use with a new paintball gun we are calling the Splotcher. Walls, floors, roofs, stairs, doors, and other structures can take on a fresh coat of color, giving you even more ways to make your corner of Brookhollow Park your own.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 ’s new DMZ mode is here! Following the release of Campaign Early Access last week, Modern Warfare 4 ’s new action extraction mode is arriving early ahead of its global launch of October 23 for XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, Steam, Battle.net, and other platforms.
If you’re unfamiliar, DMZ is the new extraction mode available exclusively with Modern Warfare 4 where you’ll deploy to the massive Hajin map, gather valuable resources, and extract before enemy forces eliminate your Operator. Success will depend on not only what you bring into each deployment, but how you recruit, develop, and protect your Operators. This guide will cover many of the starting basics to help get your boots on the ground and into action. Let’s get started.
Recruitment and Preparing for Active Duty
Your first task: Assign an Operator to one of your Active Duty slots – the Operator you pick is locked to that slot until they are dismissed by you in favor of a replacement recruit. Starting out, you’ll begin with two Active Duty Operator slots, and another unlocks as you progress through your DMZ Player Levels.
Every Active Duty Operator carries a Dog Tag that can be removed after elimination by an enemy combatant during a DMZ deployment. Dog Tag quality rises as the Operator progresses, completes exfils, and is the key to earning Traits. Any Dog Tags you collect will appear in your Loadout profile, which records the Dog Tag type, any bounty on the Operator, and the human Operators you’ve eliminated.

packages.headline: How Final Fantasy Resonance uses Visions to change how we see the series

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
From Cloud to Zidane, get a deeper insight into the RPG’s gameplay transforming cameos.
How Final Fantasy Resonance uses Visions to change how we see the series
With its cinematic HD-2D visuals and flashy combat, Final Fantasy Resonance was already piquing the interest of turn-based RPG fans, but its powerful and fun Visions mechanic has really captured the imagination. I went hands-on with the final game to take a deep dive into what Visions are, how they work, and how they transform main characters Rain and Lasswell’s quest to save their world.
If you’re familiar with summons in turn-based RPGs, then that’s a good starting point for Visions – but you’ll get a particular kick out of them if you’re a long-time Final Fantasy fan. As I explored Lapis, I encountered crystal shrines that each welcomed me to engage with a short tale of a hero from previous games in the series.
After an introduction with video clips and multiple choice questions relating to the chosen Vision, I was gifted with a combat-ready assist companion that could be equipped to one of Final Fantasy Resonance’s main party members, granting different magic and attacks in combat, but also permanently enhancing baseline stats like health and speed.
With so many legendary Final Fantasy heroes spanning 16 main numbered titles, series veterans will be pleased to know that a staggering 26 companions are available to find across the entire game.
These range from iconic villain Sephiroth (Final Fantasy VII) and amnesiac rebel Terra (FFVI), to the first Warrior of Light (Final Fantasy) and stoic battler Lightning (FFXIII). There’s also a handful of original characters from the game Final Fantasy Resonance has adapted and enhanced here, Final Fantasy Brave Exvius, such as Black Mage Tronn.
But by far the most spectacular use of a Vision’s power is their Resonance capability. By staggering all opponents during combat – finding their weakness and depleting their stagger meter – I was given the choice of using any of my equipped Visions’ dazzling cinematic finishers, such as Cloud’s (Final Fantasy VII) brutal Ascension Resonance. 
Let’s not get it twisted – Visions may initially look like regular summon attacks, but there’s far more to them than just that. In fact, Final Fantasy Resonance has more traditional summons in the shape of Espers who can join your battles for a set number of turns.

Magenta Down: A Journey Across a Hostile Exoplanet
Magenta Down is designed around a simple premise: you and your crew have crashed and are now scattered across the surface of a harsh, remote exoplanet. With limited supplies and surrounded by hostile terrain, can you find your crew and escape?
We wanted to create an atmospheric journey about moving forward and enduring the consequences of the decisions you make along the way. For us, that’s what makes an adventure interesting, facing difficult decisions with imperfect knowledge and living with the repercussions.
While enduring the planet’s weather and radiation, you’ll need to manage your current condition and decide where to head next. That might mean moving towards flashing lights because they often mark a downed supply pod, or the beacon of a recently rebooted antenna array in hopes of learning where the next industrial outpost is located.
Whether you’re moving across the surface or making your way through a decommissioned mining facility, these traversals can be tense. For example, getting caught in a storm will greatly increase your radiation exposure while also limiting your visibility. As your Geiger counter crackles and your radiation meter ticks upward, it becomes increasingly important to be on the lookout for signs of creatures, valuable supplies, and places where you can shelter from a storm.
Over the course of the journey, we provide various ways to learn about the challenges ahead, prepare for them, and mitigate the threats you face. Whether that means gathering information from a crash location or facility before you journey out, making strategic use of scarce supplies, or simply being careful and observant, we’ve worked hard to build a concise, focused journey that rewards thoughtful and deliberate gameplay.
Magenta Down is coming in 2027, and we’re looking forward to sharing more as we get closer to release.

Think You’ve Beaten Fountains? Prove it in the Gauntlet
A bit confused about what Fountains is like? This gameplay trailer should clear things up.
Here’s the deal. Fountains has ten boss fights, and the Gauntlet throws every single one of them at you back-to-back. If you own the Shattered Shape expansion, you’ll be able to choose that variant of the Gauntlet and face those bosses too. Each boss stalks their own arena, and every victory teleports you straight to the next showdown.
Haven’t picked up the game yet? There’s never been a better time. Fountains: Extended Edition (containing the base game and the DLC) is now 20% off, so you can jump in and take on the challenge yourself!
Want to give Gauntlet mode a try yourself? The Gauntlet update is live now in Fountains !
So, what exactly is the Gauntlet Mode? Think of it as the ultimate proving ground for warriors who crave a real challenge. Originally designed on PC to accommodate the most demanding souls-like connoisseurs, it’s now arriving on XBOX just after the console version’s premiere.
It’s your turn to test your mettle!
Built for the most demanding players, the Gauntlet gives you something to sink your teeth into after the credits roll. It’s a place to push your skills to the limit, and emerge victorious… or not at all.

packages.headline: 『パルワールド』謎の新アプデ「Side by Side」発表、今年冬配信へ。ゾーイ・アウリ・サヤが意味深に並ぶ

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
ポケットペアは10月20日、『Palworld / パルワールド』向けの新アップデート「パルワールド：Side by Side」を2026年冬に配信すると発表した。
『パルワールド』謎の新アプデ「Side by Side」発表、今年冬配信へ。ゾーイ・アウリ・サヤが意味深に並ぶ
ポケットペアは10月20日、『 Palworld / パルワールド 』向けの新アップデート「パルワールド：Side by Side」を2026年冬に配信すると発表した。
『パルワールド』は、モンスター収集オープンワールドサバイバルクラフトゲームだ。舞台となるのは、不思議な生き物パルたちの暮らす島。プレイヤーはさまざまな能力をもつ野生のパルたちをパルスフィアによって捕まえ、彼らの能力を活かして島での日々を過ごしていく。

packages.headline: Palworld Fans Crown Their Favorite Pal in New Poll as Winter Update Is Teased

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Sekhmet is Palworld's homecoming queen, according to a new poll published by creator Pocketpair. The kitty-shaped Pal was voted the most popular by global players, scoring 49,637 votes.
Palworld Fans Crown Their Favorite Pal in New Poll as Winter Update Is Teased
Sekhmet is Palworld 's homecoming queen, according to a new poll published by creator Pocketpair. The kitty-shaped Pal was voted the most popular by global players, scoring 49,637 votes. Solenne came in second with 37,425 votes, and Chillet was third with 34,625 votes. Spare a thought for little old Verdash, who, despite a green bouffant that would make any '90s emo kid proud, was at the bottom of the rankings with 1,479 votes.
Alongside the results, Pocketpair also teased a new update for this winter , Palworld: Side by Side. When I say "teased," I mean gave us three human silhouettes, sending the fandom into speculation mode about who the hidden characters could be. The prevailing Reddit theories are that the mystery figures are Auri, Zoe, and Saya, which would make sense, given that they were the top picks for most popular characters in the character rankings in the Pocketpair poll. All three are already in-game as faction leaders, or tower bosses, and given that Pocketpair made Zoe a recruitable companion after last year’s poll, it could mean that Side by Side will let players team up with the trio.
In an interview with Gaming World Interviews at Gamescom in August, Pocketpair head of publishing and communications John “Bucky” Buckley teased that Palworld’s next update would include something fans have been asking for. Pocketpair hasn’t confirmed whether that’s Side by Side. He also suggested the update’s timing was chosen to steer clear of November, presumably to avoid GTA 6’s release.
If you're planning on heading back to the Palpagos Islands, take a look at all the new Pals added in Palworld 1.0 , plus a guide to all the Palworld bosses , and our interactive Palworld map .
Auri, Zoe, and Saya... is that you?

packages.headline: Shrek 2 Remastered Reveal Trailer Parodies GTA 6, Sets November Release Date

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Shrek 2 Remastered is real, and its release date is less than a month away.
Shrek 2 Remastered Reveal Trailer Parodies GTA 6, Sets November Release Date
As revealed during today's ID@Xbox showcase for October 2026, Aspyr Media has recreated a cult classic tie-in game from the original Xbox era for 2026. Shrek 2 Remastered is a modern version of Activision's co-op video game that will allow players to relive swampy memories when it comes to Xbox Series X/S next month, November 10.
The reveal trailer offers a sneak peek at how fan-favorite playable characters and classic moments from DreamWorks' fairytale sequel have been upgraded with improved graphics, new features, and more. It's been a while since players were able to play as Shrek, Fiona, Donkey, Gingy, and more, but you can get a taste of some of what's in store in the footage below.
You may have noticed that the opening isn't something from the original Shrek 2. Aspyr took today's announcement trailer as an opportunity to acknowledge the elephant in the room: That its November release date puts it within spitting distance of Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto 6 . Set for release just nine days later, November 19, GTA 6 seems to have convinced most other games to steer clear of its launch window – but not Shrek.
Instead of shooting for a different date, Shrek 2 Remastered is sticking to its November 10 plan. The trailer takes a tongue-in-cheek jab at Rockstar's latest, going as far as to not only recreate its Vice City vibe but even come up with its own version of that iconic Grand Theft Auto box art, too.
The original Shrek 2 video game , meanwhile, launched in 2004 and came to the GameCube, PlayStation 2, and original Xbox. While we wait for the remaster to launch in just a few short weeks, you can check out a summary for the original experience below:
"Go beyond the film as you guide Shrek and all his pals on a thrilling, squad-based action-adventure for four players. Voyage through familiar haunts like Shrek's swamp. Tag-team baddies and use each character's special abilities to solve puzzles and accomplish mission objectives."

packages.headline: 'Haven't Played Your Console in a While?' Trade It in, Xbox Tells Customers Amid Stock Shortages

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Xbox is sending emails to customers reminding them that they can trade in their Series X and S consoles if they’ve been collecting dust.
'Haven't Played Your Console in a While?' Trade It in, Xbox Tells Customers Amid Stock Shortages
Xbox is sending emails to customers reminding them that they can trade in their Series X and S consoles if they’ve been collecting dust. The email has reportedly been sent to customers in the U.S. who haven’t used their console in some time.
The past year or so has seen console prices skyrocket thanks to the 'RAMpocalypse' sparked by generative AI companies such as OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and Microsoft itself gobbling up components. As these AI companies vie for dominance and hoard all the RAM, prices soar for the end user while hardware is harder than ever to get hold of.
Valve’s Steam Frame VR machine was originally supposed to launch for $750 , for example, but thanks to the crisis created by AI companies, it ended up costing over $1,000. Meanwhile Nvidia graphics cards are way more expensive than they used to be.
Console price rises and shortages come at the worst time for both Sony and Microsoft, with November's launch of GTA 6 expected to spark a surge of interest in all things gaming. Given the game launches on console only, Rockstar's epic is sure to lead to a dramatic rise in PS5 and Xbox Series X and S sales. The only problem is, will Sony and Microsoft be able to meet demand?
With this in mind, you can see why Xbox would want people to hand over dormant consoles to new players. Here's what the email, verified by Windows Central , says:
“Haven’t played on your console in a while? If you’ve moved on to Xbox on PC or another way to play Xbox games, it may be time to trade in your console to Best Buy.”
This initiative was actually announced in June , when Microsoft said these consoles would be refurbished and resold at lower prices to make machines more readily available for customers. "We are working with retail partners on new programs to provide previously played consoles at lower prices," Microsoft said at the time. "Players who are ready to upgrade or no longer use their console will be able to trade it in with participating retail partners for cash or store credit. Those consoles will then be made available at lower prices for players."

packages.headline: ‘It Represents an Evolution of the First-Person Shooter’ — Why Infinity Ward Is Giving Extraction Shooters Another Shot in Modern Warfare 4’s DMZ Mode

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
‘It represents an evolution of the first-person shooter’ — why Infinity Ward is giving extraction shooters another shot in Modern Warfare 4’s DMZ mode.
‘It Represents an Evolution of the First-Person Shooter’ — Why Infinity Ward Is Giving Extraction Shooters Another Shot in Modern Warfare 4’s DMZ Mode
The last time Call of Duty attempted an extraction shooter, we were living in a world without Arc Raiders in it. The DMZ beta that came with 2022’s Modern Warfare 2 was a valiant first draft, but one that ultimately failed to hook a sizable player base with its shoot, loot, and extract loop. Now the genre’s outlook is seemingly very different, with a boom in player interest thanks to the initial success of Embark Studios’ sci-fi shooter at the back end of 2025. With its popularity not quite where it was some months ago, the jury remains out on whether extraction shooters will ever be able to topple the battle royale anytime soon, if ever. But Infinity Ward is willing to try to find that out for itself with Modern Warfare 4 and its DMZ mode — the studio’s second shot at such an idea.
IGN spoke to Joe Cecot, Modern Warfare 4’s multiplayer creative director, to learn all about why Call of Duty is returning to the extraction shooter, and what was learned from its MW2 beta.
“So to me, DMZ and the extraction shooter represents an evolution of the first-person shooter,” he says. “When I think about classic Quake, my first love, to Modern Warfare and Halo and the 5v5 or the 6v6, into the evolution into Battlefield and the big war into Battle Royale. After that, for me, it's like the extraction shooter is taking the MMO plus the Minecraft plus the first-person shooter, PVP, and we'll put it all on this big melting pot, and then we'll let players go find their own fun. So to me, it represents kind of an evolution of how players play video games as well.”
Only time will tell if DMZ can have the same impact on the extraction shooter space as Warzone did on battle royale. Included as part of Modern Warfare 4, rather than as its own game or free-to-play service, it’s available to play now.
For more of Modern Warfare 4, check out our review of the campaign and whether Infinity Ward considers this to be the end of the reboot series .
Call of Duty's latest mode goes head-to-head with Arc Raiders.
“The group of people that work on DMZ love DMZ, and they loved [the MW2 version]” reveals Cecot. “Even though the beta was very hard to make, we were very proud and happy with what we made, and we learned a lot.”

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
HARRISONWORLDは10月20日、田舎暮らしシミュレーションゲーム『復興しよう！温泉町』を12月7日に早期アクセス配信開始すると発表した。
“ダブル主人公“日本田舎暮らしシム『復興しよう！温泉町』12月7日に早期アクセス配信へ。海も山も大満喫な少女と忙しそうな町長の凸凹町おこし
パブリッシャーのHARRISONWORLDは10月20日、饼饼 Studioの手掛ける田舎暮らしシミュレーションゲーム『復興しよう！温泉町』を12月7日に早期アクセス配信開始すると発表した。対応プラットフォームはPC（Steam）。日本語表示および音声にも対応する予定だ。また本作は、本日10月20日から開始の「Steam Nextフェス」に参加し、新たな体験版の配信もスタートしている。
『復興しよう！温泉町』は日本の田舎町を舞台にしたスローライフが楽しめるシミュレーションゲームだ。プレイヤーキャラクターの杏子は、転勤してきた母に付き添って山あいの素朴な温泉町へと引っ越してくる。町には未だにインターネットもほとんど届いておらず、母はこの町に通信基地局を作る手伝いにやってきたのだ。杏子はこの町で夏休みをゆっくりと満喫しながら、いろいろな人々と出会い、町に再び活気を取り戻すための手助けをしていくことになる。
舞台になる温泉町には、都会のような慌ただしさや時間に追われる日々はない。昼下がりに田園をのんびり散策し、夕暮れ時には足を止めて、空いっぱいに広がる夕焼けを眺めるといった、穏やかな時間を過ごしながら、どこか懐かしい夏の風景を楽しめるという。舞台は狭い田舎町ではありながら、海と山に囲まれ、少女の杏子の足で見て回るにはかなり広大なマップが用意されている。
また、温泉町で過ごす3日目からは、杏子だけでなく、温泉町の町長もプレイヤーキャラクターとして選択可能に。この町で生まれ育ってきた町長と、他所からやってきた杏子の二人の視点から、町に活気を取り戻す物語を見ていくことができるようになるようだ。その日の操作キャラクターとして選択しなかったキャラクターも、プレイヤーの行動に合わせて自分の一日を過ごしていくという。
本作を制作している饼饼 Studioは中国の個人開発者。作者は「クレヨンしんちゃん」や『放課後少年』といった作品に大きく影響を受け、本作『復興しよう！温泉町』でも、それらと同じように温かい思い出をプレイヤーに届けたいとの考えから制作をおこなっているという。ゲーム体験の向上のため、本作の体験版からのフィードバックなどは積極的に募集している。体験版をプレイした人は早期アクセス版の開発に向けた意見を送ってみるのもいいだろう。
『復興しよう！温泉町』はPC（ Steam ）で12月7日に早期アクセス配信開始予定で、ストアページによると日本語表示および音声にも対応する。体験版は現在配信中だ。

packages.headline: 『ARC Raiders』のPvEモードテストは「3000万回以上」プレイされていた。ただし公式いわく“賛否両論”、今後どうするかじっくり判断へ

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
ネクソンおよびEmbark Studiosは10月20日、『ARC Raiders』のPvEマッチメイキングの結果について報告した。
『ARC Raiders』のPvEモードテストは「3000万回以上」プレイされていた。ただし公式いわく“賛否両論”、今後どうするかじっくり判断へ
ネクソンおよびEmbark Studiosは10月20日、『ARC Raiders』のPvEマッチメイキングの結果について報告した。日本時間10月13日から20日にかけておこなわれたテストでは3000万回以上のPvEプレイがおこなわれたという。一方で賛否両論の反応が寄せられたそうで、データ分析とフィードバックを踏まえて今後の対応を判断するとしている。
『ARC Raiders』はPvPvE形式の脱出TPSだ。対応プラットフォームはPC（Steam/Epic Gamesストア）/PS5/XBOX Series X|Sで、ソロプレイまたは最大3人でのチームプレイに対応している。本作の舞台はARCと呼ばれる謎の機械によって荒廃した未来の地球。プレイヤーはレイダーと呼ばれるならず者のガンマンとなり、ARCや敵対するほかのレイダーなどと地表で戦う。そして、戦闘や探索を通じて手にした貴重な物資を、地下居住区スペランザへと持ち帰ることを目指す。
本作ではプレイヤーと敵対するARCとの戦闘だけでなく、他のプレイヤーとの戦闘も同時に展開されるPvPvEのゲームプレイが採用されている。一方でプレイヤーと敵対しないPvEモードを望む声も少なくなく、そうした状況を受けて今回のPvEモードのテストが実施されたかたちだ。ちなみに9月24日のPvEマッチメイキングテストの告知内では、PvPを好むプレイヤーはサービス開始以来34％程度、友好的なプレイヤーは増加傾向で37％であることが報告されている。
『ARC Raiders』はPC（ Steam / Epic Gamesストア ）/ PS5 / XBOX Series X|S 向けに販売中だ。
